title: AVO-lite score contract
description: One JSON object printed to stdout by $AVO_SCORE_CMD <candidate-dir>. Exit 0 means the evaluation COMPLETED (pass or fail); non-zero exit means infra failure (a tick error, never a correctness fail).

correct.description: HARD GATE, evaluated first and alone. false => candidate rejected, objective ignored.

objective.description: Single higher-is-better scalar the ratchet compares. REQUIRED (number) in mode=rank. May be null or a monotone coverage counter in mode=discover.

metrics.description: The quality vector: named numbers for context read-back and dashboards. Include stddev when the scorer averaged repeated runs.

note.description: One line: what changed and why the score moved. This is what the NEXT agent reads.

artifacts.description: Paths (profiles, logs) to copy into the run dir.
